The book delves into Freud's examination of guilt, which he frequently ties to the Oedipus myth, exploring its deep roots in both individual psychology and cultural development. It highlights guilt as a pivotal aspect of Freudian psychoanalysis and discusses its interplay with other psychoanalytic theories, including debates with contemporaries like Carl Gustav Jung and Melanie Klein. The book is part of the "Figures of the Unconscious" series and is accessible under a Creative Commons license.
